nativeBaseline.reference: decorative placeholder with authored loading context

library: provide decorative block, line, and circle placeholder geometry without semantic loading state
disable non-essential animation for prefers-reduced-motion and retain a visible forced-colors fallback
consumer: provide aria-hidden=true on every decorative skeleton shape
communicate loading state through an appropriate surrounding aria-busy region or authored status message when users need that information
replace skeleton presentation with truthful loaded, empty, error, permission, or other authoritative state
choose dimensions that approximate only structure the application actually knows

notes: CSS cannot add accessibility attributes; loading semantics remain an author responsibility.
Skeleton does not own asynchronous operation state, progress, retry, cancellation, or timing policy.
